articles.title: Casting a first line
articles.lead: A fish that ignores one cast may be swimming at a different depth.

sections.title: Lure, depth and tension
sections.text: Equip a rod and lure at a fishing spot. Choose your direction and cast strength. Let the lure sink before giving it a rhythm. Once a fish bites, keep the tension indicator inside the yellow band. Ease off when the fish fights and reel as the line slackens.

sections.title: Make the catch useful
sections.text: Check a Manillo shop’s recipe before using fish as items. A purchase asks for named species and quantities. If you are chasing fishing points, try a different spot or improve your record for a species you already have. Gyosil in Lyp takes pupils at 3,000 points.

articles.title: Dragon crystal gazetteer
articles.lead: Each glint in the field can add a form to Meditate. Two glints belong to different travellers.

sections.title: Water and fire
sections.text: Fou-Lu’s Water Gem is in the Sanctum and gives him Serpent. Ryu finds the Fire Gem on Mt. Giga for Wyvern. At the lifts, explore the side ledges and look for the glint on the rock.

sections.title: Earth, wind and the flawed stone
sections.text: For Behemoth, search the overgrown mound on the Tidal Flats. For Mutant, break the false wall with Ershin and descend En Jhou to its Flawed Gem. For Myrmidon, check the bushes off the scorched ground near Fou-Lu’s Tomb.

sections.title: Changes in battle
sections.text: Some forms grow into a stronger version when you use them after reaching a Game Points threshold. Their names change in the menu, for example Wyvern to Weyr. Mini-game performance contributes to those points.

articles.title: Calling a dragon
articles.lead: Ryu can change form himself, or call on another dragon for a single intervention.

sections.title: Find the command
sections.text: Meditate changes the fighter taking the turn. Evocation is a separate option in Ryu’s Abilities. His audience with the Wind Dragon precedes his first call, Rainstorm, which arrives later at the shrine during the story.

sections.title: Rest between calls
sections.text: After using a particular evocation, stay at an inn to regain that call. Saving in camp alone will not replenish it. Take the party to an inn before setting out if a boss plan relies on a call you have already spent.

articles.title: The seven dragon calls
articles.lead: Follow the dragon sightings across the two continents and the inland sea.

sections.title: Wind, grass and mud
sections.text: Rainstorm comes through the story at Sinchon. Ask Tarhn about the shining bird and follow it across the Golden Plains for Healing Wind. Revisit the singer’s overlook near the Dam for Mud Flow.

sections.title: Sand and trees
sections.text: Jump the dune into the enclosed oasis on the Shyde–Shikk sandflier course for Onslaught. On the road between Shikk and the checkpoint, take the side exit inside the question-mark area. The new map path leads to Holy Circle.

sections.title: Water and stone
sections.text: Sail north-west of Shikk and use Explore by the reef to find Flood Tide. The Salt Stone at the Fane is a separate encounter. South of Chiqua, discuss the many shapes of dragons with the traveller by the river. Visit the quarry he reveals for Fulguration.

sections.title: Kaiser control
sections.text: Collect all seven evocations to give Ryu control of Kaiser in battle. Reaching every gem location is a different collection. Compare the command list in Ryu’s Abilities with the seven calls above to find a missing visit.

articles.title: Getting back with Shift
articles.lead: Make Shyde your first stop when you want to revisit the eastern map.

sections.title: Find the teacher
sections.text: At Shyde, climb up to the puppeteer above the sandflier dealer and speak to her. Shift then lets you select destinations from the world map. Use the in-game map command shown for your layout.

sections.title: Open the route once
sections.text: If a place is missing, travel its connecting map road in person and check again. Shift is useful for returning to teachers, inns and settlements after opening routes. The sandflier and ship still have their own journeys and discoveries.

articles.title: The two stones at Shikk
articles.lead: A stone used at the shrine and a stone shown to the sailors have different jobs.

sections.title: Offer the Wave Stone
sections.text: Explore the lower flooded passage in the Fane for the Wave Stone. Carry it back to the inscribed slab and offer it there. The upper entrance leads to the audience that gives you the Salt Stone.

sections.title: Get everyone aboard
sections.text: Back at the pub, show the Salt Stone to the sailor who challenged you. In the contest at the edge of the dock, draw him to the edge and strike from behind. The later tests take the crew into the hold. Talk to the captain when the party is ready to sail.

articles.title: Keep the Flawed Gem
articles.lead: One payment for directions costs a dragon form. Two others use replaceable items.

sections.title: Commission a pot
sections.text: Ask about the informant’s offers, then order a pot in Koshka. While it is being made, explore En Jhou. Break the suspect wall with Ershin and descend past the hanging treasure. The English pickup message calls the crystal an Earth Gem. Check your key items for its actual name, Flawed Gem.

sections.title: Pay in fish instead
sections.text: The informant also takes the requested fish for shisu, including Sea Bream, Salmon or Martian Squid. Three of one accepted species are sufficient. Check the handover prompt and choose your catch or the pot. You can keep the gem even after the river route opens.

articles.title: The Tomb’s two Beads
articles.lead: Two block puzzles lead back to the same central shaft.

sections.title: A bridge, then a ride
sections.text: For the first Bead, move the purple blocks until you can jump a continuous line to the middle. In the darker room, get on the cube yourself. Roll east, north twice, west, then north to reach the other Bead. Ride back to the central shaft.

sections.title: Two different targets
sections.text: At the tablet, the enemies labelled I and II resist opposite kinds of damage. Direct spells at I and weapon strikes at II. Watch everyone’s HP after Revolution before queuing the next turn. Return with Won-qu’s Gem and take the block that offers to move ahead.

articles.title: Castle seals and shortcuts
articles.lead: Use the castle’s rest room and coloured seals to keep track of your descent.

sections.title: From the key to blue
sections.text: When the entrance crystal admits the party, use the bed if needed. Have Ershin strike the furniture to dislodge the key. Open the stair gate and find Dragonne below. Its regeneration stops after a breath attack. Pick up the Blue Charm from the battle site.

sections.title: From yellow to red
sections.text: On 1F, the north lift goes up to the optional blue door on 5F. The south lift goes down to B1. At the yellow rope, continue south over the bridge. Beyond the ladders, the north passage leads to the Shaman’s Ring. Turn south instead for the lever. Raise the bridge and pass beneath it to find the charm.

sections.title: Back at the rope
sections.text: On the way back, use the lever to restore the crossing. Unseal the rope and go down two flights. At the Red Charm, go south for five Life Shards or east for the lift. The last diary lies north of the lift exit.

articles.title: Surviving the palace fights
articles.lead: Prepare for a run of fights where one healer may be too slow. Later sections reveal the final opponents.

sections.title: Before the inner palace
sections.text: Water resistance helps against A-tur’s Frost Breath. At Dragonne, use a dragon breath early to remove its healing. At the next save point, set aside an ordinary save and check your supplies for group healing and status recovery.

sections.title: When you oppose the emperor
sections.text: Tyrant can spread several status effects at once. Avoid putting all your healing options in the same active trio. Astral follows Tyrant and can use Soul Rend to drop the front line to 1 HP. Give a group heal priority over a long attack chain on that turn.

articles.title: Finish a combo with a party skill
articles.lead: A third character can turn a linked spell pair into a personal finisher.

sections.title: Choose the third action
sections.text: Queue the two elements in the order shown. Have the named character follow with a melee skill while the combo is active.

articles.title: Armour for Ershin
articles.lead: After rescuing Cray, return to the smith on Mt. Glom with three spare parts.

sections.title: Set aside the parts
sections.text: Keep unusual salvage when clearing your inventory. The smith uses three pieces for each suit. You can use three copies of the same part.

sections.title: Try a known recipe
sections.text: Three Glass Shards make a Psychometer for Ershin. Three Iron Scraps make a Mithril Rig. Save in camp before handing over scarce parts if you want to compare the results.

sourceSections.section: Materials and armour results, PC cross-check

articles.title: Beyd’s Pabpab notebook
articles.lead: Read the diary in the neighbouring tree house before you go looking for medicine.

sections.title: Listen for the request
sections.text: Nah means fish. Rikuku means medicine. Examine the sick Pabpab, then return to Beyd. Ask the man on the balcony in Lyp where to sail for Mozweed.

sections.title: The four rocks
sections.text: After giving the herb to the patient, spend the night and talk to the Pabpabs in the sickroom again. Sail from Lyp and look for four rocks in a straight line. Face along the line and search. Land on the island for the Divine Helm.

sourceSections.section: Pabpab to English and Beyd’s notes

articles.title: Behind the cracked wall at Mukto
articles.lead: When the lift brings you out of the Tomb, Mukto has a second path beside the exit.

sections.title: Open the ruins
sections.text: Save outside. Cross the gap east of the tomb exit, then follow the ledge north into the cave. Put Ershin in front and ram the cracked south wall.

sections.title: Take the shrine route
sections.text: Descend the steps. The bag across the gap holds four Swallow Eyes. Return to the ledge and follow the door and ladders up to the ruined shrine for the Dragon Tear.

sections.title: If Rider appears
sections.text: Rider is an optional encounter in the ruins. Its equipment includes King’s Armor as a steal and the Cursed Sword as a possible drop. Bank your finds before trying for either piece.

articles.title: After the credits
articles.lead: The party’s ending offers a Clear Game save when the credits finish.

sections.title: Keep the two files
sections.text: Use a different memory-card file for Clear Game if you want to revisit the decision at the throne. Load the cleared file to return to the world map with your progress.

sections.title: The Abandoned Village
sections.text: Return to the village near Chek. Rei and Teepo now run a shop there. Speak to Teepo for the Rusted Sword. There is also a treasure trader who can cover a missed upgrade from Ludia.

articles.title: Finding the treasure collectors
articles.lead: A collector upgrades the ball you bring by one tier. Your route decides which ball you receive at each stop.

sections.title: Keep the night appointment
sections.text: Buy the Lead Ball from the frog in the Sarai tavern for 158 zenny. On the night you rescue Cray, find the trader outside Ludia’s south-west building. After the credits, the Abandoned Village offers a replacement trade.

sections.title: Look for Marlok in Synesta
sections.text: Bring at least a Tin Ball to Marlok. Visit him again with better treasure to learn his remaining skills.

referenceTables.title: Collectors by region
rows: The man in the shrine exit hut and the prisoner beneath Wyndia Castle.
Shyde and the eastern return trip
The trader under the raised walkway in Shyde, the digger back at Crash and the girl in the Synesta orphanage.
The basement near Shikk’s entrance, the fish merchant in Chiqua and the woman in the fields at Sonne.

articles.title: Spending Manillo stamp cards
articles.lead: At a blue Manillo’s fish counter, each trade earns shop points as well as the item you bought.

sections.title: Claim the stamps
sections.text: Use the shop’s Triangle prompt after a trade to put stamps on your card. Each 100 shop points buys one stamp. Twenty stamps fill a card, so one full card costs 2,000 shop points. Your fishing score for Gyosil is a separate record.

sections.title: Spend or save
sections.text: Keep full cards for the merchant’s card exchange. Three cards buy one stat item. If you want the Linked Pole or the Render weapon, each early exchange sets your total back.

referenceTables.title: Prices in full cards
rows: One Magic Shard, Power Food, Swallow Eye or Fish-Head

articles.title: Bandits’ Hideout
articles.lead: Marlok sends Ryu, Cray and Ershin after the thief. Before leaving Synesta, ask the merchant beside the town gate where he went.

sections.title: Take the eastern road
sections.text: Leave Synesta and enter the question mark on the eastern path. After the encounter, follow the route to the hideout. Enter through the cleft in the rock and head east into the clearing.

sections.title: Close a gap before taking chase
sections.text: Put Cray in front. Push barrels together across an opening in the southern half of the room. Approach the thief, then watch where his route turns back at the barricade. Cut across to meet him.

sections.title: Return or recruit
sections.text: Catching the thief frees you to return to Marlok, then go north to the Sandflier Wharf. For an optional master, re-enter the hideout and talk to Stoll. He asks for every zenny you carry, so buy any supplies you want first.

referenceTables.title: Enemies in the hideout
rows: The bats appear in a group of four.

articles.title: Wyndia Castle basement
articles.lead: After visiting the oracle in Kasq Woods, speak to the king again. Enter the windmill on the north side of Wyndia Castle and descend past the guard.

sections.title: Take the north fork for a Soul Gem
sections.text: Enter the eastern doorway below the stairs. The north branch ends at a chest. Return to the fork, turn south and follow the northeast passage to the revolving windmill.

sections.title: Watch the vane
sections.text: When the fan turns away, dash into the northeast branch for three Swallow Eyes. Return to the fork and take the northern passage between gusts.

sections.title: Ride the turning platforms
sections.text: Wait on the first platform until it faces the northern ledge. Cross and take the next platform east. Its short southern landing leads to a Balance Ring. To continue, cross to the eastern platform and leave by its east ledge.

sections.title: Take shelter in the alcoves
sections.text: Move north between gusts and step into a recess when the wind rises. The east recess holds four Healing Herbs. Two FlashGrenades are farther up on the west. Go through the north door and take the Wind Flute from the pedestal. Retrace the route to the surface, then head northeast to Pung’tap.

referenceTables.title: Enemies below the windmill
rows: Guard for Feign Swing or Distracted.
Douse requires a special encounter condition. The usual basement group does not supply its Drake partner.

articles.title: Mt. Glom
articles.lead: Ride from Tarhn’s camp to the smoking mountain. Its moving plates change position when a battle ends.

sections.title: Find the plates
sections.text: Jump across the first gaps and take the northern opening. A western side path leads to a Fire Ward. Come back and continue north into the platform room.

sections.title: Ride a plate
sections.text: Step onto the southeastern plate and stay there until a battle finishes. Check which neighbouring plate you can now reach. The chest near the starting plate contains 600 zenny. For the way to the smith, change plates as they meet and work towards the northeast exit.

sections.title: Take a weapon for Ershin
sections.text: From the northwestern part of the moving room, turn the camera towards the western wall. The doorway you can reach when the plates align leads to a Drill Punch. Return to the plates and leave to the northeast.

sections.title: Find the smith
sections.text: Follow the ladders and bridges up to the smith’s house. He asks for a Faerie Drop to make a King’s Sword. Leave for Wychwood and inspect the faerie light. Bring the drop back when you have it.

referenceTables.title: Beside the main route
rows: The first room’s western side passage.
Chest reached from the starting southeastern plate.
Hidden western doorway beside the moving plates.
Beyond the smith’s house, down the steps to the southwest.

kurok.title: Kurok ridge
kurok.objective: Take the lower fork to the Dam.
kurok.mapAlt: From the Chamba entrance, pass Rwolf and reach the western fork. The upper branch ends at the red Deep Diver chest. Double back and take the lower branch west to reach the Dam road.

steps.title: Enter from Chamba
steps.body: Follow the ridge to Rwolf. He can take an apprentice here. Keep walking past him to reach the fork.

steps.title: Choose a branch
steps.body: Beyond Rwolf, the western trail splits. Stay low to continue the story. Climb the upper branch first if you want the fishing lure.

steps.title: Open the red chest
steps.body: The upper path ends on a ledge. Take the Deep Diver from the chest, then retrace your steps to the same fork.

steps.title: Leave by the lower trail
steps.body: Take the downhill branch and keep west. When the world map appears, choose the newly opened road to the Dam.

optional.name: Deep Diver
optional.advice: Open the red chest at the dead end. Return by the same path.

enemies.name: Mage Goo
enemies.detail: 200 HP. Use Guard when it casts Burn for a chance to learn the skill.

enemies.name: Scorpion
enemies.detail: 280 HP. Use Guard when it uses Blind for a chance to learn the skill.

enemies.name: Flue Goo
enemies.detail: 320 HP. Watch for Giant Growth. Its base reward is 40 EXP.

enemies.name: Red Cap
enemies.detail: 300 HP. Watch for Command in a mixed encounter.

kurok.evidence: The US PlayStation Lab run documented the ridge chest, its Deep Diver reward and the western exit. Enemy statistics and skills come from the cited battle reference.

dam.title: The Dam
dam.objective: Collect the gate-bank chests before returning the Sluice Key.
dam.entry: When both engines have lowered their gates
dam.mapAlt: Two chests are above the gates. After crossing the first gate, climb the ladder for the Short Sword. Across the second gate, climb the eastern ladder for two Swallow Eyes. Two Vitamins are on the lower bank, reached from the exit beside the flywheel. Return to the work camp only after collecting all three chests.

steps.title: Climb for the Short Sword
steps.body: Cross the first lowered gate. On the far side, climb the first ladder. Open the chest on the upper ledge.

steps.title: Take the lower exit for Vitamins
steps.body: At the second engine, leave through the lower exit beside the flywheel. Open the outdoor chest for two Vitamins, then return to the upper walkway.

steps.title: Climb the eastern ladder
steps.body: Cross the second lowered gate. Climb the ladder at the far end for the chest containing two Swallow Eyes.

steps.title: Give the key back
steps.body: Take the east tunnel to the work camp. Descend the ladder from the far gallery. Face north at the blue lever and lower the bridge. Cross it to the foreman when you are ready to leave.

optional.name: Short Sword
optional.where: Upper ledge at the first gate
optional.advice: Cross the lowered gate and take the first ladder.

optional.name: Vitamin ×2
optional.advice: Use the lower exit beside the second engine.

optional.name: Swallow Eye ×2
optional.advice: Cross the second gate and climb the eastern ladder.

enemies.name: Puspool
enemies.detail: 300 HP. Fire hardens it. Use Guard for a chance to learn Molasses.

enemies.name: Tadpole
enemies.detail: 580 HP. Watch for its resting turn. Guard for a chance to learn Snooze.

dam.warning: Before you return the Sluice Key to the foreman, collect the Short Sword, two Vitamins and two Swallow Eyes. The Dam closes after the handover.

after.title: After you give the key back
steps: When the bell sounds, take the Crank back across the bridge and fit it to the lift. If the handle sticks, tap your mapped Cross button to lower the lift.
Go north on the world map and enter the ! stop. Pay the bard 100 zenny for the dragon song. The 10-zenny tadpole tune is optional. Afterwards, take the eastern road to Kyria.
after.evidence: The US PlayStation Lab run paid 10 zenny for the tadpole song and 100 zenny for the dragon song, then continued east to Kyria.

dam.evidence: The US PlayStation Lab run recorded all three rewards, the key exchange and the failed attempt to re-enter after the flood. This diagram separates elevations and the work camp. See the walk from the camp for the earlier engine instructions.

opening.title: From the work camp
steps: Descend the two ladders. Take the upper west-tunnel door and follow the tunnel to the wooden platform. Cross the gap in the planks to meet the foreman. Walk back to Rhoppe, the worker in a pink swimming ring, for the Sluice Key.
Return to the first control panel and use the key. Climb back outside and cross the gate you just lowered. The first ladder on the far side leads up to the Short Sword chest.

Save before starting the second engine if you want another try at the flywheel prize. From the sword ladder, take the lower path to the second engine. Roll the directional buttons in a circle either way. Start slowly, then speed up. When the wheel sounds high-pitched, press your mapped Circle button. If Ryu starts sweating, he is tiring. Speak to the worker afterwards for the prize.

kyria.title: Kyria village
kyria.objective: Enter the mayor’s house from below and find out where he went.
kyria.entry: Coming from the bard on the Dam road
kyria.mapTitle: The bridge and the two pits
kyria.mapAlt: Cross the bridge to the mayor’s house. The cat circles the pit with the ladder into the house. The chicken circles a different pit with 400 zenny. Speak to the parrot, then go back to the village gate for the western road to the Woods.

steps.title: Cross the village bridge
steps.body: Leave the Manillo and the inn by the entrance. Cross the bridge towards the mayor’s house. A cage blocks the front door. Look behind the house for a cat pacing round a patch of ground.

steps.title: Drop into the cat’s pit
steps.body: Drop through the southern pit circled by the cat. Follow the short ledge to its ladder and climb into the mayor’s house. The northern pit by the chicken leads to the 400-zenny chest and the barrel shed.

steps.title: Get an answer from the parrot
steps.body: Inside, check the bookcase beside the bird for a Fish-head. Tell the parrot you have no time, then decline its next three offers. On the US PlayStation version the choices are 2, 2, 3, 4. Now ask where the mayor is.

steps.title: Take the western road
steps.body: Leave through the front door and return across the bridge. If the foot trap catches you, clear its message and keep walking. The innkeeper can heal the party and offer an ordinary save. Leave town and go west on the world map to the Woods.

optional.name: Fish-head
optional.advice: Check the bookcase next to the parrot. It holds one Fish-head.

optional.name: 400 zenny
optional.advice: Drop through the chicken’s pit. Take the first short drop and open the chest. A second drop leads to the floor below. Climb the ladders to the barrel shed and put Cray in front to push a barrel aside.

optional.name: Belladonna
optional.advice: Trigger the bridge trap and speak to the villager beside the bridge. If the gift has not appeared, spring other village traps and speak to the villager again.

optional.name: Ice Punch
optional.advice: Open the chest behind the inn and fight the three enemies named ????. The Ice Punch comes from that one-time battle.

optional.name: Bronze Shield
optional.advice: Defeat the BeeTroop with its shield intact for a chance at the shield. Cast spells instead of striking it with weapons.

enemies.detail: Two of the three chests have only 1 HP. The real one has 300 HP and can run away. Clear the decoys to lower its magic resistance, then defeat it for the Ice Punch.

enemies.name: BeeTroop
enemies.detail: 800 HP. Use magic while its shield is intact to keep the Bronze Shield drop available. Guard when it uses Wild Swing. Breaking the shield lets it use Risky Blow, another learnable skill.

kyria.warning: Save at the inn before opening the trapped chest if you want the Ice Punch. Its carrier can flee. At the doghouse, use magic if you want the BeeTroop’s shield. Weapon hits can break it.

after.title: When you return with the mayor
steps: After the night at the inn, climb out when Cray falls in. The zigzag path uphill north of the mayor’s house now leads to the passage for Synesta.

kyria.evidence: On the US PlayStation disc, the northern cellar led to 400 zenny and the barrel shed. The southern ladder led to the parrot and one Fish-head. The party saved at the inn and later returned from the Woods for the mayor’s invitation.

kyria-woods.title: Kyria Woods
kyria-woods.objective: Pass under the broken bridge and climb the falls to find the mayor.
kyria-woods.entry: Arriving from Kyria after speaking to the parrot
kyria-woods.mapTitle: From the apple tree to the falls
kyria-woods.mapAlt: Follow the woodsman’s sign east to the well. Go under the broken bridge and leave the trap clearing by its eastern opening. Jump the river stones. At the top, the western branch holds a Wisdom Seed; the northern branch leads to the mayor and Maman.

steps.title: Find the man by the apple tree
steps.body: Follow the winding entrance path to the man blocking the way. Speak to him for an Apple. Put Ershin in front and ram the nearby tree for more. Pass the man and follow the sign east to the well.

steps.title: Pass under the broken bridge
steps.body: In the trap clearing, take the path east from the well. Go under the broken bridge and through the eastern opening to the riverbank. Baiting a stump shows where a boar runs; you can walk straight through to the river without an apple.

steps.title: Jump up the falls
steps.body: From the riverbank, jump to the rock beside the waterfall, then to the far bank. Follow the ledges uphill. At the top, the western jump is a dead end with a Wisdom Seed. Jump back to the fork to continue.

steps.title: Take the northern trail
steps.body: Heal at the fork, then take the high northern path to the mayor. Maman’s Rock Blast hits the front rank. When everyone can spare a turn, queue Ryu’s Hwa followed by Nina’s Sever for a two-hit combo. Keep a Healing Herb ready.

optional.name: Apples
optional.advice: The man gives you one Apple. Ram the tree with Ershin to collect more. Each Apple restores 100 HP; you can also use one as bait.

optional.name: Healing Herb ×4
optional.advice: From the well, go up the east ramp and pass the stump. Fall into the pit beside the hanging cage. Open the chest and climb out through the well.

optional.name: Earth Ward
optional.advice: Bait the stump up the incline east of the well and follow the tracks. To find it yourself, go south from the hanging chest past the cage and enter the southern treeline before the downhill ramp.

optional.name: PointedStick
optional.advice: Go south from the well and up the slope by the hanging plate. From the next cage, climb the short northern rise. Stand under the suspended chest to collect Nina’s weapon.

optional.name: Aura Ring
optional.advice: From the cage south of the hanging chest, follow the trees to the southern edge. Go east down the ramp and up the next. Drop through the pit at the top to reach the ring. The ladder returns to the well.

optional.name: Apple ×8
optional.advice: Bait the stump south of the hanging chest. Its trail leads to a gap in the eastern treeline on the upper ledge, behind the hanging stone. Open the chest in the glade.

optional.name: Wisdom Seed
optional.advice: At the top of the falls, jump across to the western dead end. Take the seed from the bag, then jump back to the fork.

enemies.name: Flue Goo
enemies.detail: 320 HP. Watch for Giant Growth. A Flue Goo gives 40 EXP before bonuses.

enemies.name: Red Cap
enemies.detail: 300 HP. Watch for Command when other enemies are present.

enemies.name: Maman
enemies.detail: 3,600 HP. Body Press hits one character. Rock Blast hits the front rank. An Apple buys time to heal and gives Maman 100 HP. Ryu’s Aura can use Flame Strike. Victory earns the Flame Punch, 1,500 EXP and 450 zenny. You can steal an Apple or find one alongside the weapon.

enemies.name: Cap
enemies.detail: 170 HP. Use Guard when it loses interest and uses Distracted. Berries can be stolen; a Healing Herb can drop.

enemies.name: Fungoid
enemies.detail: 420 HP. Guard when it orders the other enemies with Command. Its powder can confuse the party.

enemies.name: Bandit
enemies.detail: 500 HP. Expect Sever and Healing Herb. Its steal is a Moon Sword; its drop is a Healing Herb.

after.title: After the clearing
steps: Return to Kyria from the world map. The mayor invites you to stay at the inn and promises to open the passage to Synesta in the morning.
After the night at the inn, climb out of Cray’s pit. Take the uphill path north of the mayor’s house. The cavern on the far side leads to the well in Synesta.

kyria-woods.evidence: On the US PlayStation disc, Ershin knocked Apples from the tree. The party crossed the clearing without bait, collected the western Wisdom Seed and defeated Maman. The reward screen showed one Apple, one Flame Punch and 450 zenny. The optional boar trails use the cited walkthroughs.

kyria-passage.title: The passage to Synesta
kyria-passage.entry: From Kyria, the morning after finding the mayor
kyria-passage.objective: Follow the stream through the mountain and climb out through the town well.
kyria-passage.mapTitle: From the shallows to the well
kyria-passage.mapAlt: The stream leads from Kyria to a deep pool. Cross the stepping stone to the dry fork. Take the south branch to the flooded steps and climb to the well. Three short detours lead to the east-bank chest, the north spur and a ledge beside the steps.

opening.title: Finding the entrance in Kyria
steps: The mayor opens the way after the night at the inn. Climb out of the village pit if Cray falls in. Cross the bridge and follow the rising road north of the mayor's house to the cavern.

steps.title: Cross the first stream
steps.body: Follow the entrance tunnel to the shallows. The eastern bank leads to a chest with a Water Bomb. For the way through, stay in the stream and head upstream.

steps.title: Jump the deep pool
steps.body: Follow the stream to the deep pool. From its west bank, face the exposed stone and press Jump once to cross east. Follow the far bank round to the tunnel.

steps.title: Take the south fork
steps.body: The short north branch ends at an Ammonia chest. Come back to the fork and take the southern tunnel. Follow its bends to the opening at the far north end.

steps.title: Climb the flooded steps
steps.body: Wade to the stone steps and climb. For 500 zenny, take the western spur and jump north across the gap to the chest. Retrace your steps to the fork and climb to the high opening.

steps.title: Climb the well ladder
steps.body: Go through the opening at the top of the steps. Follow the upper tunnel to the short well shaft. Climb the ladder to reach Synesta’s paved terrace, beside the stairs.

optional.name: Water Bomb
optional.advice: Wade straight across the first stream. Follow the eastern bank into its dead end and open the chest. Walk back to the stream.

optional.name: Ammonia
optional.advice: In the dry tunnel, take the north arm of the fork to the chest. The southern arm is the way onwards.

optional.name: 500 zenny
optional.advice: Turn west partway up the stairs. At the end of that spur, jump north to the ledge. Open the chest, then jump back towards the steps.

enemies.name: Army Bat
enemies.detail: 8 HP. At exactly 1 HP it can use Shadowwalk. Have someone Guard to learn it. Leave this for a later encounter if your weakest attack defeats it.

enemies.name: Puspool
enemies.detail: 300 HP. Guard to learn Molasses. A fire hit raises its EXP from 60 to 120 and removes its chance to drop a Silver Top.

enemies.name: Tadpole
enemies.detail: 580 HP. Leave it at half health or higher and Guard for Snooze. Below half health it can use Devour instead.

enemies.name: Cadaver
enemies.detail: 1,000 HP. Guard early in the fight to learn Feint. Its moves change when it is close to defeat.

enemies.name: Zombie
enemies.detail: 650 HP. Fire is effective. Ershin can use the Flame Punch from Kyria Woods.

after.title: At the well
steps: For the town story, enter the orphanage across from the well. To go back for treasure, wait for the arrival conversation to finish, face the well from the terrace and press Confirm to climb down.
The town gate also opens a world-map road back to Kyria. You can collect all three cave chests on a later visit.

kyria-passage.evidence: A US PlayStation party collected the Water Bomb and Ammonia, climbed into Synesta, then descended the well for the unopened 500-zenny chest. All five listed enemies appeared in battle. The skill conditions come from the enemy tables.

teachers.name: Rwolf
teachers.join: Speak to Rwolf beside the ridge path. He accepts an apprentice on your first visit.

will.name: Haste
will.effect: Helps allies act earlier in battle.

teachers.name: Stoll
teachers.join: Give Stoll all the zenny you are carrying.

will.name: Filch
will.effect: A normal attack can steal an item the party has yet to collect.

teachers.name: Una
teachers.join: After fighting Kahn in Worent, apologise to Una upstairs. If she asks for a stronger combo, return after dealing 1,000 damage in one chain.

will.name: Wild
will.effect: Physical attacks hit harder but miss more often.

teachers.name: Njomo
teachers.join: Build a house in the faerie colony, then visit Njomo.

will.name: Pique
will.effect: A counterattack lands a critical hit.

teachers.name: Momo
teachers.join: Speak to Momo inside the windmill. Check the play time on your save before returning for a lesson.

will.name: Drowse
will.effect: The apprentice falls asleep in the back row and recovers HP and AP.

teachers.name: Abbess
teachers.join: Return to the Abbess after securing a dragon’s help on the pilgrimage.

will.name: Reck
will.effect: Guard has a better chance to learn an enemy skill.

teachers.name: Marlok
teachers.join: Trade up to the Tin Ball or better and visit Marlok.

teachers.name: Kryrik
teachers.join: Show Kryrik a combo of at least 25 hits.

will.name: Finale
will.effect: The apprentice can follow up against a weakened enemy.

teachers.name: Gyosil
teachers.join: Score at least 3,000 fishing points before asking Gyosil to teach you.

will.name: Ward
will.effect: Using an item can leave it in the inventory.

teachers.name: Lyta
teachers.join: Have a party member apprentice to Gyosil, then visit Lyta at the orphanage.

will.name: Guard
will.effect: The apprentice can intercept a hit aimed at a badly wounded ally.

teachers.name: Kahn
teachers.join: After your encounters with Kahn, seek him at the roadside stop north of Saldine.

will.name: Valor
will.effect: The apprentice sometimes gets back up after a knockout.

teachers.name: Bunyan
teachers.join: Recruit the other eleven masters. Leave the roadside clearing by its hidden path to reach his house.
